subject: Retention carve-out request & evidence checklist for NorthBridge Therapeutics
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northbridge-thera.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthBridge Compliance <compliance@northbridge-thera.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary retention carve-out + evidence checklist

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the throughput. Before we proceed to procurement, compliance has a specific ask we need to evaluate: for a subset of tenants handling investigational trial telemetry, NorthBridge requires retention of certain inference and request logs for 180 days rather than Redwood's default 90-day ephemeral retention.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
- Provide a temporary carve-out that preserves pre-token and request traces and audit logs for 180 days for a single tenant ID (we'll provide the tenant ID once we get agreement)
- Deliver an inventory of log types and their storage scope (what we call "retention inventory")
- Supply CAIQ/SIG mappings that show which controls are impacted and where evidence artifacts live (for our SOC 2 review)
- Produce a sample "proof-of-delete" artifact after retention expiry (hashed manifest or certificate)

We would appreciate a checklist of the exact artifacts your team can provide and any contract amendment language you'd need. I'm copying our compliance lead Raj (raj.patel) who may chime in with technical specifics.

Thanks,

Laura Chen
Sr. Privacy & Compliance Manager
NorthBridge Therapeutics

Attachments: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northbridge-thera.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:04:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retention carve-out + evidence checklist

Laura — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can accommodate a tenant-scoped retention extension for specific log classes; we'll need to align on technical scope and signature language for the SOW.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope the inventory and evidence correctly:
- Which log categories do you need in the 180-day window? (e.g., request traces, model input/output payloads, audit events, scheduler/job logs)
- Is this retention extension expected to be limited to a single tenant for a pilot, or should we prepare language for potential wider rollout?
- Are there any data residency constraints (EU/UK) or is everything US-based?

I'll loop in Kim from Security & Compliance for the CAIQ/SIG mapping and Priyom from Solutions for how we record proof-of-delete artifacts and deliverables. We'll produce a retention inventory template and a sample proof-of-delete along with suggested contract text. Expect a follow-up by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
On Tue, Jul 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Laura Chen <laura.chen@northbridge-thera.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted)

From: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northbridge-thera.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:37:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retention carve-out + evidence checklist

Hi Laura — Kim from Security & Compliance here. Thanks for laying out the requirements; below is what Redwood can commit to for a tenant-scoped 180-day retention carve-out and the artifacts we can provide for your SOC 2 review: 

Scope we can extend (tenant-scoped):
- Audit events (role changes, token issuance, admin actions) — retained 180 days
- Request metadata + headers and per-request KV cache keys (no full model weights) — retained 180 days if in-scope
- Structured system diagnostics (limited PII) — retained 180 days where contractually allowed
- Note: We do not retain customer PII payloads beyond explicit contract allowances; sensitive payloads must be redacted via agreed prompt filters.

Evidence artifacts Redwood will provide:
1) Retention inventory spreadsheet (attached) mapping log type -> retention window -> storage class -> accessible export path.
2) CAIQ mapping PDF (attached) showing which CLA/CCP controls are impacted and where supporting artifacts live (we reference CAIQ v4 control IDs we map to our SOC 2 controls).
3) Proof-of-delete sample: a post-retention hashed manifest and timestamped deletion event entry (attached sample). After retention expiry we'll provide this manifest for the tenant.
4) Access to a temporary read-only export for forensic review (one-time export, gated via support ticket and RBAC).
5) Audit trail archive (subset) that includes who requested the export and when; we can provide an attestations log entry for compliance records.

Contract amendment suggestions:
- SOW clause: "For specified tenant(s) [Tenant ID(s)], Redwood will retain the log categories listed in Attachment A for 180 days from creation. Customer agrees to accept limited-scope, redacted payloads where necessary to comply with privacy constraints."
- Deletion attestation: "Upon completion of the 180-day retention period, Redwood will provide Customer with a hashed manifest and deletion timestamped event, and will retain the deletion audit record for 365 days."

Attachments included: retention inventory, CAIQ mapping, proof-of-delete sample. I'll also upload the CAIQ crosswalk to our confluence page for your reviewers.

If that looks good, Marcus and I can draft the attachment language and Priyom can scope any engineering work / ticketing needed.

Thanks,
Kim Park
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: northbridge_retention_inventory_20260714.xlsx; redwood_caiq_mapping_2026.pdf; proof_of_delete_sample_20260714.txt

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@northbridge-thera.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@northbridge-thera.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:48:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retention carve-out + evidence checklist

Kim/Marcus — this looks reasonable and covers what our auditors asked for. Two quick asks before we start SOW work: 
1) Can you confirm the redaction guidance you mentioned (what fields are redacted by default) so we can update our internal data flow diagrams?
2) For the proof-of-delete, can you confirm the hashing algorithm and whether Redwood will sign the manifest (we prefer SHA-256 + Redwood's signing key or an HSM timestamp).

If you can provide answers to those two points and a draft Attachment A we can route the amendment through procurement next week. Happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Compliance Lead
NorthBridge Therapeutics

---
Requested next steps: Marcus to coordinate draft SOW attachment; Kim to confirm redaction fields + signing approach; Priyom to inventory ticket for engineering to enable tenant flag and export path.
